source.claim: Participant 04 could not reliably discover the relevant technical substrate through its available general web-search/fetch tool envelope.

readings.rationale: The participant explicitly reported its available tools and access limitations.

methodological_limitations: Search-index discoverability is not equivalent to repository-native availability.
The participant review was institution-commissioned and must not be promoted into stronger external validation than the method supports.
counter_readings: Failure to discover the repository proves the repository is absent.
Participant refusal or access failure proves the tested system failed.
unresolved: W-05 / M3 Fielded semantic rubric was not cleanly tested by Participant 04.
